line: Crowley's account of Atu XV: the letter Ayin, Capricorn ruled by Saturn, and the figure of Pan.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter, the sign, its ruler and the name Crowley gives the figure. The table spells the letter A'ain, against the text's Ayin.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter ‘Ayin, which means an Eye, and it refers to Capricornus in the Zodiac.
The sign is ruled by Saturn, who makes for selfhood and perpetuity.
The card represents Pan Pangenetor, the All‐Begetter.

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley says this path leads from Tiphareth, with the far end not named in the text. The table gives Key Scale path 26.

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Atu XIII and XV are symmetrically placed; they lead from Tiphareth, the human consciousness, to the spheres in which Thought (on the one hand) and Bliss (on the other) are developed.
